notes.title: MAC DEMO IS LIVE!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43789507/2e66bfc326aff61d3b096380b11250195f822072.png"][/img][/p][p]We're happy to let you guys know that the Mac Build of our demo is now live. We've been playtesting and ensuring you can complete the demo without any issues. Make sure to join our discord or post in the Steam Community with any reports/concerns/questions! 

We work 7 days a week, there is no shortage of the passion we have for this game and making it more accessible to anyone. If you're a mac user, I really hope you can enjoy and love oneway.exe's demo. We have so much more planned. [/p]

notes.title: Two updates! (Mac demo issues, and subtitles)
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43789507/2e66bfc326aff61d3b096380b11250195f822072.png"][/img]

We're currently having a few issues with our Mac demo that we are hopeful can be ironed out by today. We will do our best to ensure our demo is the best version it can be for all Mac users, but ask for your patience in the meantime![/p][p]On another note, we wanted to make the quick update that subtitles are actively being worked on and will be implemented as soon as possible! We understand how important it is for accessibility and so it's something that's been in the works for a while now.[/p][p]Expect to see subtitling very soon.[/p][p]Thank you for your interest in our Demo, we really appreciate your understanding![/p]

notes.title: Deactivating our Demo until Next Fest!
notes.content:
It's tricky, but we have decided to deactivate the demo we currently have up and playable, in anticipation for the much improved demo we have been working on for June's Steam Next Fest.

[b]We really want this new upcoming demo to be someone's first impression of our game[/b], we are super proud of it and have learned so much since last October. I guess that is the thing about being first time devs, everything is a learning experience and you want put your best foot forward!

For those who have played the demo already, know there [b]will be new content[/b] to experience as well! I hope the differences make [b]the playing experience even better, smoother, scarier[/b] for you.

Thank you for your patience and support until this point, it has been the biggest motivation in our day-to-day dev work. 

[b]See you June 9th! [/b]
